name: Hernádnémeti (Hungary)
description: Three horizontal stripes of blue, white and blue in the ratio 1:1:1, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hernádnémeti: a blue shield with a white soldier holding a sabre on a green base.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
